statement: The standard-library schema-1 diagnostic reader validates a bundle directory, completion JSON or bounded capture tree. It checks completion status, final file-list position and payload timestamps, exact dimension-derived PFM and LVID sizes, little-endian encodings, ordered draw/mesh joins, explicit unsupported coverage, capture-manifest camera and resolution, and same-pixel probes in every plane. Nonfinite samples are invalid findings reported per plane. Reads use verified regular-file handles and bounded buffers; unknown versions, partial payloads and descendant links are refused. Equal timestamps are accepted; schema 1 has no recorded sizes or checksums and cannot prove historical write order. Registered synthetic Python regressions run without a renderer. Render-health comparison optionally validates an associated capture when its completion sidecar exists. Runtime bundle integration remains pending; ROI image metrics are recorded separately; no required CI check is added.
